title: BioInteract: Interpretable Drug--Target Interaction Prediction via Residue-Level Cross-Attention with Protein-Language and Physicochemical Priors
description: Second-revision release for the BioInteract Davis-benchmark binary high-affinity interaction classifier. It adds the matched-protocol comparison harness, in which every architecture is trained under one shared partition, seed, optimiser, schedule, loss and validation-selected threshold; the ordered row-level BindingDB filtering audit, applied both to the pre-specified curated-articles snapshot and to the complete BindingDB release; the frozen external evaluation on the larger full-release cohort; and the applicability-domain analysis that places every external ligand and target relative to the Davis training distribution. The interactive web application now reports the same two nearest-neighbour scores for each submitted pair. The release also contains source code, frozen configurations, archived checkpoints, canonical full-precision entity-split predictions and metrics, strict-split artifacts, figure-generation scripts, and reproducibility manifests. External transfer remains limited; the release is not evidence for broad DTI generalisation, structural contacts, binding pockets, or mechanisms. Peer-review correspondence is not included.
